sections.title: Graduate Critique II
sections.description: Graduate Critique is designed to introduce students to different pedagogical methodogies relating to the citical examination of works of art as well as to assist students in terns of speaking about their own work. This course provides a democratic and interactive forum for the voicing of opinion in an informed context. This course is required for MFA students in the 2nd semester of the program.
